courthouses.name: Siskiyou County Superior Court (Yreka Courthouse)
courthouses.hours: Office: Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. and 1:00–5:00 p.m. Phones generally 8–12 and 1–4 (Traffic phones 10–12 and 1–3).
courthouses.note: The only courthouse location the court lists. Divisions: Criminal, Traffic & Other Infractions, Civil, Family Law, Small Claims, Collaborative Courts. Criminal arraignments, misdemeanor, felony and traffic matters are all handled here.
courthouses.todo: No separate criminal clerk phone on the official site (a third-party directory lists (530) 842-8182 — not verified). Department numbers/assignments not published on pages loaded.

public_defenders.name: Siskiyou County Public Defender's Office
public_defenders.note: County-run office. Represents indigent adults charged with felonies or misdemeanors and juveniles, on appointment by the judge (ask at your first court appearance; you fill out a financial form). Does not handle infractions, civil or family law. Fax (530) 842-0135. Public Defender: Lael Kayfetz.

public_defenders.name: Siskiyou County Conflict Panel (private attorneys)
public_defenders.note: When the Public Defender has a conflict, the case goes to the Conflict Panel of local private attorneys, assigned by the Conflict Administrator.
public_defenders.todo: Conflict Administrator contact not published on the county page

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Redding Office
legal_aid.serves: Low-income residents of Lassen, Modoc, Shasta, Siskiyou and Tehama counties
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing, public benefits, education rights, health benefits, grandparent guardianship. The Redding office page does NOT list criminal record remedies or criminal defense.
legal_aid.note: 1370 West Street, Redding, CA 96001. Toll-free (800) 822-9687. Evening intake message line (866) 815-5990.

legal_aid.name: Siskiyou County Bar — Private Attorneys list
legal_aid.what: Link to private attorneys, provided on the County Public Defender page. Fees apply.

programs.name: Adult Drug Court / Adult Recovery Court
programs.summary: Alternative to incarceration for eligible defendants through a partnership of the court, probation, behavioral health, legal and law enforcement agencies. The court page says eligibility criteria apply but does not list them.

programs.name: Mental Health Court
programs.summary: Treatment and rehabilitative services for defendants with mental illness as an alternative to the traditional court process.

programs.name: Veterans Court
programs.summary: Resolves veterans' criminal cases through treatment and support, with frequent meetings with a judicial officer, other veterans, providers and mentors.

programs.summary: The Sheriff's Custody Division lists a Day Reporting Center and Alternative Sentencing page and a Sheriff's Alternative Work Program application. Eligibility not summarized here — ask your attorney or the jail.

jails.name: Siskiyou County Jail
jails.phone_note: Jail line per Custody Division page. Sheriff HQ (305 Butte St.): (530) 842-8300; Records (530) 842-8301 / 8303.
jails.note: County's only adult jail (104 beds; holds pre-trial felons and sentenced misdemeanor and felony inmates). 'both' is based on the Sheriff's Inmate Orientation Manual, which has separate Women/Female and Men/Male worker sections. Visits are non-contact in room V-1, by housing unit; 18+ (immediate family minors with an adult). Money deposits via JailATM (http://www.JailATM.com, linked by the Sheriff); commissary packages via Access Securepak. Court is the only courthouse in the county (nearest, not confirmed by the Sheriff). Juveniles needing detention are held at the Tehama County Juvenile Detention Facility in Red Bluff per Siskiyou Probation.
